verse.verse_1: We sent this (the Holy Koran) down on the Night of Honor.
verse.verse_2: What could let you know what the Night of Honor is!
verse.verse_3: The Night of Honor is better than a thousand months,
verse.verse_4: in it the angels and the Spirit (Gabriel) descend by the permission of their Lord upon every command.
verse.verse_5: Peace it is, till the break of dawn.
